results.title: Aravali Marriott Resort & Spa, Delhi NCR Brings a Fresh Culinary Experience to Olive Grove
results.description: A food and beverage experience that brings together chef-crafted burgers, refreshing brews, friends, family, and relaxed poolside moments. Delhi NCR, July 2026: Aravali Marriott Resort & Spa, Delhi NCR invites guests to discover a refreshed culinary experience at Olive Grove, its elegant poolside bar, with the launch of the all-new Burger & Brews menu. Thoughtfully curated by the resort's culinary team, the menu features a selection of gourmet, chef-crafted burgers, each paired with a complimentary beer, offering a relaxed yet elevated dining experience in a picturesque open-air setting. Overlooking the resort's signature outdoor swimming pool, Olive Grove is one of the four distinctive dining destinations at Aravali Marriott Resort & Spa. Celebrated for its handcrafted cocktails, premium beverages, and tranquil alfresco ambience, the venue has become a preferred destination for leisurely afternoons, casual gatherings, and sunset soirées. The vegetarian selection features the Classic Aloo Patty Burger, a comforting favourite with a perfectly spiced potato patty, fresh vegetables, and melted cheese. The Mushroom & Emmental Burger offers rich earthy flavours, elevated with subtle hints of truffle, while the Healthy Quinoa & Lentil Burger brings together wholesome grains, lentils, and seasonal vegetables for a nourishing yet flavourful bite. Each burger is paired with a complimentary beer, making it an ideal choice for a leisurely poolside meal. For non-vegetarian diners, the menu presents the bold Diablo Chicken Burger, featuring a flavourful chipotle chicken patty, alongside the Smashed Chicken & Cheese Burger, layered with juicy smashed chicken, cheddar, and tangy gherkins. Completing the line-up is the Jerk Spiced Lamb Burger, showcasing a succulent slow-cooked lamb patty topped with caramelised onions and creamy feta cheese. Every burger is served with a complimentary beer, creating a perfectly balanced dining experience that complements Olive Grove's relaxed outdoor setting. Whether it's a leisurely poolside lunch, an evening catch-up over refreshing brews, or a relaxed weekend meal with family and friends, Burger & Brews at Olive Grove promises an experience that blends gourmet comfort food with the warmth of Marriott's signature hospitality. Set against the backdrop of lush surroundings and a serene poolside ambience, the refreshed menu reflects Aravali Marriott Resort & Spa, Delhi NCR's continued commitment to curating distinctive culinary experiences that celebrate quality, craftsmanship, and effortless luxury. Date: 15th July -31st July Timings: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM Outlet: Olive Grove (Poolside Bar)

results.title: Kiyapo causes widespread flooding in Iloilo, Antique
results.description: ILOILO CITY - Flooding inundated at least 40 barangay in Iloilo City and some parts of Antique on Friday, July 24, due to the continuous rains brought by the southwest monsoon, enhanced by Tropical Cyclone Kiyapo. In Iloilo City, floodwaters reached waist-deep in several areas, affecting communities in all seven districts of the city. The district of Molo recorded the highest number of flooded barangay with 12. The city government said 109 families, or 435 individuals, were evacuated as floodwaters continued to rise. Of the total, 52 families, comprising 156 individuals, were temporarily sheltered in evacuation centers. As of 2 p.m., evacuation centers were accommodating residents from Barangay Calubihan and Barangay San Vicente in Jaro; Barangay San Antonio and Barangay Infante in Molo; Barangay Don Esteban in Lapuz; and BarangayTicud in La Paz. The Iloilo City Emergency Operations Center was placed under Blue Alert Status on Thursday afternoon. Meanwhile, in Antique, the provincial government reported flooding in Barangay Calala and along the boundary of Calacja I and Aldea in Hamtic town. Rescue responders on Friday transferred passengers to a rescue truck to bring them to safety after the bus they were riding was stranded after getting stuck in a roadside canal submerged by floodwaters. Authorities also used lifeboats to ferry motorcycles across a flooded section of the national highway in Hamtic after deep floodwaters made the road impassable to light vehicles. The Antique Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council advised motorists to avoid the Iloilo-Antique Road via Bukid due to the threat of additional rain-induced landslides and instead use the Iloilo-Antique Coastal Road as an alternate route. The persistent rains also disrupted classes across Western Visayas. According to the Department of Education, 1,380 schools in 47 municipalities and Iloilo City suspended face-to-face classes, affecting 481,034 learners. The suspensions covered all 14 municipalities of Antique, all five municipalities of Guimaras, 28 municipalities in Iloilo province, and Iloilo City. The Regional Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (RDRRMC-6) placed its Operations Center under Blue Alert Status effective Friday morning as weather disturbances continued to threaten Western Visayas. The state weather bureau forecast 50 to 100 millimeters of rainfall over Aklan, Antique, Iloilo, Guimaras, and Negros Occidental between Friday noon and Saturday noon, warning that localized flooding and rain-induced landslides remain possible, especially in vulnerable communities. The Mines and Geosciences Bureau has identified 264 villages in Western Visayas as susceptible to flooding and rain-induced landslides, including 98 barangays in Iloilo, 107 in Antique, and 59 in Guimaras. As of July 23, the Department of Social Welfare and Development had P156 million worth of standby funds and prepositioned relief supplies ready for emergency response. These include P3 million in standby funds, 174,651 family food packs — with 33,210 stored at the regional warehouse in Oton and 142,441 prepositioned across 71 local government units — as well as 28,956 ready-to-eat food packs and 15,361 non-food items, including hygiene kits, kitchen kits, sleeping kits, tents, and laminated sacks.

results.title: Together signs in Girona the former convergent councilor who also wanted Alliance
results.description: Ten days after leaving the municipal government of Girona , Junts has made a significant announcement for the upcoming municipal elections in the city. Alongside Gemma Geis, who will repeat as the head of the list, Carles Puigdemont's party has confirmed the incorporation of Carles Ribas as number two. A former member of Convergència and a councilor during Marta Madrenas's term, Ribas ran four years ago with his own brand, Ara Girona, but narrowly missed entering the City Council after obtaining 1,579 votes (4.6%). These were insufficient to exceed the 5% threshold to obtain a councilor but key to understanding that Junts lost half of its votes in the last municipal elections. Currently, Ribas is part of the Partit Nacionalista de Catalunya (PNC), founded by Marta Pascal , and will run in the city in coalition with Junts x Girona.
